Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone


Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title - AI Product Engineer (React + Django, LLM Agents)


About the Company

Our client is a US-based AI startup building production AI agents for marketing workflows (SEO, social media, email). The team is led by experienced founders with backgrounds at Meta, Google, and Scale AI.

This is a product engineering role, not research. You’ll build AI agents that ship, scale, and are used by real customers.


About the Role

We’re looking for a hands-on AI Product Engineer who can own features end-to-end: frontend, backend, and AI logic.

You will build AI agents inside real products, not demos — working closely with the CTO and founders to design, implement, and iterate quickly.


What You’ll Do

  • Build AI-powered product features using React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Implement LLM-based agents that perform real business workflows
  • Design and maintain RAG pipelines (retrieval, chunking, embeddings, evaluation)
  • Integrate third-party APIs, web scraping, and internal data sources
  • Own features from idea → production → iteration
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions in a fast-moving startup environment


Must-Have Requirements

  • 6+ years total engineering experience
  • 4+ years of professional experience as a software / product engineer
  • 2+ years working with LLMs, AI agents, or generative AI systems
  • Strong hands-on experience with React (frontend) and Django (backend)
  • Proven experience building AI agents or LLM-powered features used in production


Solid understanding of RAG systems, including:

  • Retrieval quality tradeoffs
  • Chunking strategies
  • Hallucination risks and mitigation
  • Comfortable working without heavy frameworks or abstractions
  • Able to explain technical decisions clearly, concretely, and concisely
  • Startup mindset: moves fast, owns outcomes, and ships
  • Experience with Pinecone, pgvector, or similar vector databases
  • Web scraping, data ingestion pipelines, or third-party API integrations
  • Prior experience in marketing, SEO, or growth-related products


Logistics

  • Full-time (40 hrs/week). US Time Zones
  • Starting ASAP

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Operations Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

This role involves overseeing ongoing AI projects , managing client relationships , coordinating with internal teams , and ensuring the successful delivery of projects .

We are looking for individuals who are not only skilled in project management but also enthusiastic about AI and eager to drive new solutions.


While technical expertise is valuable, the primary focus is on project management , product ownership and client satisfaction . This role sits in the Digital Transformation Center and will be close to delivery and research teams.

  • To encourage a culture of excellence within the team.
  • To advance AI initiatives through cross-functional collaboration.
  • To engage across functions (SMEs, technical teams, leaderships) to guarantee delivery quality.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Project Management: Lead end-to-end project management for AI initiatives, from initiation to successful delivery. Develop project plans, allocate resources, track progress, and ensure timely completion of milestones and deliverables;
  • Client Engagement: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring clear communication. Understand client needs, manage expectations, and address concerns promptly to achieve customer satisfaction;
  • Risk Management: Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies. Proactively address issues that may impact project timelines, scope, or quality, ensuring smooth project execution;

  • Team Leadership: Provide leadership and direction to project teams, fostering a collaborative and results-driven environment. Mentor team members, promote knowledge sharing, and support professional growth;
  • Global Approach: Interact with other regions, partners and ventures following a global approach to ensure consistency and alignment in AI project management across the organization.


Required Experience :

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Project Management, or a related field;
  • Experience in managing projects AI projects from conception to delivery;
  • Familiarity with AI technologies and their applications;
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools;
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate challenges and adapt to changing project requirements;
  • Critical thinking and problem solving to assess client situation and provide actionable outcome-based business/technical advice;
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or other relevant project management certifications (preferred);
  • Proficiency in English is mandatory;
  • Proficiency in Portuguese is desirable.


Required Technical Knowledge :

  • Familiarity with AI concepts, terminology, and industry trends;
  • Understanding of project management methodologies specific to AI projects;
  • Ability to evaluate technical feasibility and make informed project decisions based on technical considerations;
  • Proficiency in using project management software and tools for AI project tracking and management;
  • Knowledge and experience on conducting projects for IT and Service Desk solutions.
  • A background in IT environments, including an understanding of how various IT components and systems operate, is highly beneficial. This knowledge helps in navigating technical aspects, ensuring seamless integration of AI solutions within existing IT infrastructures;

Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll need


  • Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution

  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions
  • The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it
  • An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese

Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais.


Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro.


Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas!

Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira!

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.


Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional.


Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua.


Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Principais atividades:


  • Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização.
  • Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros.
  • Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos.
  • Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS).
  • Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança.
  • Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura.
  • Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais.
  • Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura.
  • Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral.
  • Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos.
  • Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores.
  • Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins
  • Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos
  • Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR)


Conhecimento específicos:


  • Políticas de segurança
  • Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social.
  • Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos
  • Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização
  • Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança

You'll join the Reporting & Analytics team at Pride Global — a high-impact, cross-functional group responsible for delivering data-driven insights across our global staffing operations.

This role sits at the center of how the business makes decisions. You’ll be responsible for building the reporting layer that powers executive dashboards, client presentations, and operational insights across the US, Canada, UK, and Brazil.

This is not just a dashboarding role. You’ll translate complex workforce, financial, and market data into clear, actionable narratives used by senior leadership and global business heads.

We need someone who can take ambiguous business questions, structure them into analytical problems, and deliver high-quality reporting solutions end-to-end — from data modeling to final presentation.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards used in executive-level reporting and client-facing presentations
  • Build self-service reporting solutions that allow business stakeholders to explore data independently
  • Create clean, intuitive, and visually effective dashboards optimized for both desktop and mobile consumption

  • Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and validation rules within reporting layers
  • Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic to ensure long-term scalability and governance


What We’re Looking For

Must have (3–5 years of experience):

  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, RLS)
  • Solid SQL skills (joins, aggregations, query optimization, working with relational databases)
  • Experience building reporting solutions for operational, workforce, or business performance data
  • Proven ability to design clean, executive-level dashboards with clear storytelling and minimal noise
  • Experience managing Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, access control, deployments)
  • Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively
  • Strong English communication skills (you’ll work with global stakeholders daily)


Nice to have:

Reach Surgical, a Genesis Medtech Company, is a leading minimally-invasive surgical device manufacturer and supplier, committed to serving high-quality products to healthcare practitioners and patients worldwide. We deliver advanced technology and cost effective minimally-invasive surgical products to medical institutions and provide patients with reliable and economical treatment solutions.


About the Role


We are looking for a high-performing Sales Manager to spearhead regional sales management, drive business growth, and accelerate the expansion of Laparoscopic products for Brazil.


Responsibilities


As the Sales Manager, you will be responsible for the sales management of Laparoscopic products within the assigned geographic area and markets to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets. You will conduct market research including customers and competitors’ activities and formulate and execute market development strategies. In addition, you will develop and build long-lasting relationships with stakeholders including distributors and healthcare professionals and obtain feedback on our products to internal stakeholders.


1. Development and Execution of Sales Plans


  • Sales Strategy and Execution: Define clear and measurable overseas sales goals, develop corresponding action plans, and execute them effectively to meet company objectives.
  • Market Intelligence: Conduct detailed hospital and micro-market analysis; maintain up-to-date market intelligence to understand industry trends and competitive landscapes.
  • Competitive Strategy: Formulate and implement effective competitive strategies based on insights into market dynamics and competitor activities.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Support regional marketing activities, leverage internal and external resources efficiently, and enhance overall customer value.
  • Decision-Making: Maintain a deep understanding of regional market conditions; identify emerging opportunities and potential challenges to make informed and timely decisions.


2. KOL (Key Opinion Leader) Management


  • Database Development : Establish and maintain a comprehensive overseas KOL information archive.
  • Customer Insight : Analyze the potential and specific needs of KOLs to develop targeted engagement plans.
  • Relationship Management : Strategically allocate resources to build, strengthen, and sustain long-term cooperative relationships with KOLs.


3. Distributor Management


  • Distributor Development : Identify, evaluate, and onboard distributors that meet company criteria and strategic alignment.
  • Performance Support & Training: Provide motivation, ongoing support, and training to ensure distributors adhere to company standards and deliver expected outcomes.
  • Channel Optimization : Demonstrate strong communication and distributor management skills; conduct regular performance reviews and offer actionable feedback to maintain an effective and healthy distribution network.


Qualifications & Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Management, Marketing, Trade, Life Sciences, Clinical Sciences or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in international sales or business development, preferably experience in the laparoscopic industry.
  • Proficiency in English is required
  • Strong sales and negotiation skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with experience in cross-cultural communication.

Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SENIOR GO ENGINEER | SERIES A FINTECH START-UP | REMOTE IN LATAM | $120k USD


Realm is partnered with a high-growth fintech building who have recently secured a huge Series A round and is looking to grow its team.


They're developing a payment fraud detection platform to rapidly identify and prevent fraudulent transactions. The platform will automatically detect suspicious activity and potential perpetrators, significantly reducing response times.


Who they're looking for: A backend engineer with exceptional Go programming skills (min 2 years of commercial Go experience) and a strong foundation in databases, gRPC, and scalable system architecture.


You'll work on complex problems in fintech, risk, and fraud, and have the opportunity to join an exceptional remotely distributed team of 6 who are re-inventing fraud detection.


Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for chargeback management, integrating with credit card, banking, and merchant platforms.
  • Design and implement robust microservices architecture, leveraging reusable frameworks and libraries.
  • Optimize system performance and security by leading code improvement, CI/CD enhancement, and technology upgrades.
  • Drive platform innovation by identifying improvement areas and owning feature development from inception to deployment.


Ideal candidate:

  • 6+ years of software development experience, with at least 2 years in Go production environments.
  • Proven experience in platform architecture and development.
  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills, including leading complex projects.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and deep technical knowledge.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.


Tech stack: Go, DynamoDB, gRPC, Docker, SNS/Kafka (not exhaustive)

Go, FinTech, Fraud, Cloud, Distributed Systems, Finance, Backend, Engineering, Software

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Commercial Lead — Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Regrow

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.



About the Role

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.


You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.


This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.



What You’ll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
  • Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
  • Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



Nice to Have

  • Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
  • Working knowledge of Spanish.



Why Regrow

  • Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
  • High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
  • A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.



Acerca de Regrow

Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.


Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.


Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.


Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.


Qué Harás

  • Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
  • Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
  • Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
  • Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
  • Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
  • Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
  • Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
  • Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
  • Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Deseable

  • Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
  • Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
  • Conocimiento funcional del español.



Por Qué Regrow

  • Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
  • Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
  • Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
  • Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

We operate with the intensity of a championship team, where every player is expected to bring their best, own their outcomes, and drive results.

This role exists for one reason:


…to ensure that our HubSpot data is accurate, our sales workflows function correctly, and our Sales team can operate without friction, enabling leadership to make decisions based on reliable data and drive revenue growth. If data is wrong, decisions are wrong. This role ensures that never happens.




** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:

Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.




Who You Are:


  • You are highly detail-oriented and process-driven.
  • You take ownership of problems and solve them without being handheld.
  • You move with urgency and do not let tasks sit idle.
  • You are highly experienced being the HubSpot expert and troubleshooting issues independently.
  • You are not afraid to “get your hands dirty” fixing data and cleaning systems.
  • You communicate clearly and directly.
  • You can handle a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with strong personalities.
  • You do not make excuses, rather, you find solutions.


What You’ll Do:

HubSpot Data Ownership & Accuracy

  • Own data cleanliness and accuracy inside HubSpot across the entire sales pipeline
  • Identify and fix incorrect, incomplete, or inconsistent data
  • Ensure all sales data reflects reality and can be trusted for decision-making

Workflow & Automation Execution

  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot HubSpot workflows and automations
  • Ensure lead routing, deal movement, and task assignments function correctly
  • Reduce friction for Sales by simplifying and optimizing workflows

Sales Pipeline & Reporting Support

  • Maintain and support the integrity of the deal pipeline (lead → calls → close)
  • Ensure accurate tracking of sales KPIs and performance metrics
  • Support and maintain integrations feeding into reporting systems (e.g., “Daily Dash”)

System Troubleshooting & Problem Solving

  • Diagnose issues across HubSpot, integrations, and workflows
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales team members to identify root causes
  • Implement solutions quickly without waiting for direction

Process Documentation & Training

  • Build and maintain clear, step-by-step process documentation (“point-and-click” SOPs)
  • Train Sales team members on correct system usage
  • Ensure new hires are properly set up and onboarded in HubSpot and related tools

Quality Control & System Integrity

  • Ensure all workflows, automations, and data structures are functioning correctly
  • Continuously monitor for errors, inconsistencies, and breakdowns
  • Escalate issues quickly and proactively

  • 2+ years experience managing a company’s HubSpot instance for Sales
  • Strong understanding of sales pipelines and funnel stages
  • Proven experience building workflows and automations
  • Strong problem-solving ability and resourcefulness
  • High level of proficiency in Google Sheets (formulas, lookups, data handling)
  • Ability to work independently and execute without constant direction
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Ability to work U.S. business hours consistently
  • Ability to move quickly without sacrificing accuracy
  • Bonus:
  • HubSpot certifications
  • Experience with the following integrations: Zapier, Coefficient
  • Familiarity with sales tools such as Zoom Phone or similar systems
  • Exposure to AI tools or automation platforms

At Crisp, we don’t just hire people: we build A-players.

  • Clear expectations. You will know exactly what success looks like.
  • High-impact work. Your work directly affects revenue decisions.
  • Fast-paced environment. Work moves quickly and decisively.
  • Growth opportunity. Strong performance leads to expanded responsibility.
  • Ownership culture. You are trusted to solve problems and execute.

Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, not necessarily the best lawyers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough. That’s where Crisp comes in.

At Crisp, we’re here to ensure that the best law firms, no matter their size, have a fighting chance to lead, serve, and transform their communities.


By empowering our law firm clients to succeed, we’re not just building stronger businesses; we’re creating a ripple effect of positive change that impacts lives, families, and communities across the country.


About Crisp:


Crisp is an incredibly fast-moving, high-growth company (1470%+ growth in 3 years) with a laser focus on delivering the absolute best legal marketing and business coaching services on the market today.


Check out what we are about here:


We’re all about working hard and staying humble. In the spirit of humble bragging, here are some of our awards and accolades:

  • Named to Inc. 5000 List of Fastest-Growing Private Companies for 7-Years (2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017)

  • Host of the most listened-to podcast in the legal industry

Why You Should Work Here:

If you’re looking for a job that’s boring and easy, you won’t find that here. We put 110% into everything we do. Greatness is achieved through hard work, discipline, and sacrifice, and we’re determined to be great.

  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.

  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.

  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.

Formação Acadêmica:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.



Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Estamos expandindo nosso time de tecnologia e buscamos profissionais para atuar na fronteira da inteligência artificial aplicada aos setores financeiro e securitário. O DESAFIO:


  • Orquestração e Agentes: Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph ou Agent Squad para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados.
  • Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade): Implementar o rastreamento completo da \"cadeia de pensamento\" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes.

  • Infraestrutura Cloud: Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS ou Azure e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock ou Azure OpenAI Service , priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven.
  • AI Guardrails: Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos.
  • Avaliação Sistemática: Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção.
  • Eficiência de Custos: Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Linguagens: Domínio avançado de Python e Java para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA.
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência com Docker , Containerization e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem.

VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

The ideal candidate brings an existing network, active pipeline, and proven ability to close high-value partnerships that drive stablecoin issuance, circulation, and transaction volume.


⸻


Key Responsibilities


1. Business Acquisition (Primary Focus)


* Originate, develop, and close new institutional partnerships across:

  * Tier 1 & Tier 2 crypto exchanges

  * DeFi protocols & liquidity platforms

  * Payment Service Providers (PSPs) and on/off-ramp partners

* Drive stablecoin adoption, listings, and integrations across partner ecosystems

* Convert existing relationships into live, revenue-generating partnerships within 3–6 months


2. Pipeline & Revenue Ownership


* Build and maintain a robust, active pipeline of high-quality institutional prospects

* Own and deliver against aggressive revenue and volume targets, including:

  * Stablecoin issuance growth

  * Transaction volume (on-chain & off-chain)

  * Active partner count and wallet activity

* Track and optimize conversion rates from lead → deal → volume


3. Strategic Partnerships & Distribution


* Structure and negotiate commercial agreements (liquidity, listing, distribution, yield partnerships)

* Identify and execute joint go-to-market strategies with partners

* Collaborate with product and treasury teams to align liquidity, pricing, and incentives


4. Market Leadership & Relationship Management


* Build strong C-level relationships (CEO, COO, Head of Trading, Head of Partnerships)

* Position AXCoin as a trusted institutional-grade stablecoin partner

* Represent the company at global crypto, fintech, and payments forums


⸻


Candidate Profile


Must-Have Experience


* 7 to 10 years in business development / institutional sales within:

  * Crypto / digital assets

  * Payments / PSPs

  * Fintech / trading ecosystems

* Proven hunter track record: consistently closing large, complex deals

* Existing relationships and active pipeline with:

  * Crypto exchanges (centralized & decentralized)

  * DeFi ecosystems

  * Institutional liquidity providers / market makers

  * Global PSPs and payment networks


Critical Capabilities


* Deep understanding of:

  * Stablecoins, liquidity flows, and token economics

  * On/off-ramp infrastructure and settlement rails

  * Institutional crypto trading and treasury needs

* Strong commercial acumen with ability to structure win-win, scalable partnerships

* Ability to operate in a fast-paced, build-and-scale environment


Leadership & Personal Traits


* Pure hunter mindset – relentless, proactive, and target-driven

* Highly credible with executive presence and strong negotiation skills

* Self-starter with ability to open doors and close deals independently

* Global mindset with strong cross-border relationship experience


⸻


Why Join AlloyX / AXCoin


* Opportunity to shape and scale a next-generation institutional stablecoin

* Work alongside a high-caliber leadership team with global reach

* Direct impact on building institutional-grade digital asset infrastructure

  • * Competitive compensation with performance-driven incentives

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Development Orchestrator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor de back end em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs consumed by Android and iOS clients
  • Build and maintain microservices using Java, Node.js, Python, or Go (per team stack)
  • Define and document API contracts and data schemas in collaboration with mobile developers
  • Manage database design, query optimization, and migrations (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices (OAuth 2.0, JWT)
  • Develop and maintain backend test suites; collaborate with SDETs on integration testing
  • Maintain JIRA user stories and technical tasks for backend workstream
  • Monitor service health, diagnose production issues, and lead root cause analysis
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for backend services
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and technical planning sessions

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 7+ years of backend development experience
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language: Java, Node.js (TypeScript), Python, or Go
  • Strong experience designing and building RESTful APIs for mobile clients
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or ECS)
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Familiarity with JIRA for backlog and sprint management
  • Understanding of security practices: OAuth, JWT, HTTPS, input validation
  • Experience with automated testing and integration with CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong commitment to Test Driven Development (TDD) practices for backend service quality
  • Experience building backends specifically optimized for mobile (bandwidth-efficient, low-latency APIs)
  • Familiarity with push notification infrastructure (FCM, APNs)
  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS/SNS)
  • Exposure to GraphQL API design


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

Location: Remote

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series.


Role Overview

As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.


Key Responsibilities

1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy

  • Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization.
  • Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy.
  • Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.

2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight

  • Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers.
  • Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth.
  • Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation.
  • Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.

3. Team Management & Leadership

  • Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows.
  • Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team.
  • Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team.
  • Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.

4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion.
  • Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback.
  • Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.

5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control

  • Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output.
  • Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content.
  • Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.

6. User-Centric Content Improvement

  • Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches.
  • Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges.
  • Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.

7. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets.
  • Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans.
  • Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders.

8. Promotion & Growth Strategy

  • Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows.
  • Ensure promos align with the show’s narrative hook and audience appeal.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms.
  • Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams.
  • Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Key Traits for Success

  • Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance
  • Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively
  • Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams
  • Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise
  • Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado] em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.

Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
